info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Visuals API

items.docs: Retrieves the list of visual objects in the composition tree. Visuals are the base building blocks of the visual layer, representing rectangular areas that can have size, position, opacity, clip, and transform properties. Types include SpriteVisual, ContainerVisual, LayerVisual, ShapeVisual, and RedirectVisual.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Create a composition visual

items.docs: Creates a new visual object using the Compositor factory methods such as Compositor.CreateSpriteVisual, CreateContainerVisual, or CreateLayerVisual. The visual must be added to a visual tree to be rendered.
